name: Push-up
instructions: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line, lower chest to the floor and press back up.
formCues: Keep core braced
Elbows ~45° from torso
commonMistakes: Sagging hips
Flaring elbows out to 90°

name: Incline Push-up
instructions: Hands on a bench or step, perform a push-up at an incline to reduce load.
formCues: Straight body line
commonMistakes: Too shallow a range of motion

name: Diamond Push-up
instructions: Hands together under the chest forming a diamond, lower and press up.
formCues: Elbows tucked close to the body
commonMistakes: Wrist strain from poor hand placement

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from the bar, pull your chin over the bar, lower with control.
formCues: Full dead hang at the bottom
Drive elbows down and back
commonMistakes: Kipping/swinging
Partial range of motion

name: Assisted / Negative Pull-up
instructions: Jump or step to the top position, lower yourself down as slowly as possible.
formCues: Control the descent, aim for 3-5 seconds
commonMistakes: Dropping too fast

name: Weighted Pull-up
instructions: Perform a pull-up with added weight via a belt or vest.
formCues: Same strict form as bodyweight pull-ups
commonMistakes: Adding weight before strict form is solid

name: Chin-up
instructions: Underhand grip pull-up, chin over the bar.
formCues: Squeeze the bar hard
commonMistakes: Using momentum

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Under a sturdy bar or table edge, body straight, pull chest to the bar.
formCues: Keep body rigid, squeeze shoulder blades
commonMistakes: Hips sagging

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Feet shoulder-width, sit hips back and down, drive up through the heels.
formCues: Chest up
Knees track over toes
commonMistakes: Heels lifting
Knees caving inward

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height, squat down and up.
formCues: Elbows brush the inside of the knees at the bottom
commonMistakes: Leaning too far forward

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar on the upper back, squat to depth, drive back up.
formCues: Brace core before descending
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back

name: Lunge
instructions: Step forward, lower the back knee toward the floor, push back to standing.
formCues: Front knee stays behind the toes
commonMistakes: Short, unstable steps

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on a bench, lower into a lunge, drive up.
formCues: Keep torso mostly upright
commonMistakes: Front knee collapsing inward

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, drive hips up by squeezing the glutes.
formCues: Squeeze at the top, avoid arching the lower back
commonMistakes: Using the lower back instead of glutes

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on a bench, barbell across the hips, drive hips up.
formCues: Chin tucked, ribs down at the top
commonMistakes: Overextending the lower back

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Rise onto the balls of your feet, lower with control.
formCues: Full range of motion, pause at the top
commonMistakes: Bouncing instead of controlling the tempo

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms and toes on the ground, body in a straight line, hold.
formCues: Squeeze glutes and brace the core
Neutral neck
commonMistakes: Hips sagging or piking up

name: Side Plank
instructions: Balance on one forearm and the side of one foot, hips lifted, hold.
formCues: Stack hips and shoulders
commonMistakes: Hips dropping toward the floor

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: In a plank position, drive knees alternately toward the chest at speed.
formCues: Keep hips low and stable
commonMistakes: Hips bouncing up and down

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a bar, raise the knees toward the chest with control.
formCues: Avoid swinging
commonMistakes: Using momentum instead of the core

name: Burpee
instructions: Squat, kick back to a plank, push-up, jump feet in, jump up.
formCues: Land softly
commonMistakes: Sagging plank position

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead, jump back together.
formCues: Stay light on your feet
commonMistakes: Landing flat-footed

name: High Knees
instructions: Run in place driving the knees up toward waist height.
formCues: Pump the arms
Stay on the balls of your feet
commonMistakes: Leaning back

name: Squat Jump
instructions: Squat down and explode upward into a jump, land softly and reset.
formCues: Soft landing, knees tracking over toes
commonMistakes: Landing with locked knees

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge at the hips and swing the kettlebell to chest height using hip drive.
formCues: Power comes from the hips, not the arms
commonMistakes: Squatting the swing instead of hinging

name: Walking
instructions: Brisk walk at a conversational pace.
formCues: Maintain an upright posture
commonMistakes: Pace too slow to raise heart rate

name: Jogging
instructions: Steady-state jog at an easy, sustainable pace.
formCues: Relaxed shoulders, midfoot strike
commonMistakes: Overstriding

name: Cycling
instructions: Steady-state cycling at a moderate, sustainable effort.
formCues: Knees tracking straight, not splaying out
commonMistakes: Seat height too low

name: Cat-Cow
instructions: On hands and knees, alternate arching and rounding the spine slowly.
formCues: Move with the breath
commonMistakes: Rushing the movement

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Lunge forward, rotate the torso toward the front leg, reaching upward.
formCues: Keep the back leg straight
commonMistakes: Rushing through the rotation

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, lower the bar to mid-chest, press back to lockout.
formCues: Shoulder blades pinned back
Feet flat, drive through the floor
commonMistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest
Flaring elbows to 90 degrees

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: On an incline bench, press dumbbells up and slightly together over the upper chest.
formCues: Control the descent
Don't let elbows flare past 45 degrees
commonMistakes: Bench angle too steep, shifts work to shoulders

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Standing between two cable stacks, sweep the handles together in front of the chest with a slight elbow bend.
formCues: Slight forward lean
Squeeze at the midline, don't just swing arms
commonMistakes: Using momentum instead of a controlled squeeze

name: Incline Machine Press
instructions: Seated on an incline press machine, press the handles up and away until arms are extended.
formCues: Keep shoulder blades set against the pad
commonMistakes: Locking out elbows aggressively at the top

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: At a high cable, push the bar down to full elbow extension, keeping elbows pinned to your sides.
formCues: Elbows stay fixed at your sides
commonMistakes: Letting elbows drift forward to use body weight

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Facing away from a low cable, extend the rope overhead until arms are straight.
formCues: Keep upper arms close to your head
commonMistakes: Flaring elbows out to the sides

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Bench press with a shoulder-width grip, keeping elbows tucked to bias the triceps.
formCues: Elbows track close to the torso
commonMistakes: Grip too narrow, straining the wrists

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
instructions: At a high cable with a rope attachment, push down and spread the rope apart at the bottom.
formCues: Spread the rope ends apart at full extension
commonMistakes: Using shoulders to drive the movement

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Seated, pull the bar down to your upper chest, leading with the elbows.
formCues: Lead with elbows, not hands
commonMistakes: Leaning back excessively to move more weight

name: Chest-Supported Row
instructions: Chest against a supportive pad, row the handles to your torso.
formCues: Squeeze shoulder blades together at the top
commonMistakes: Using momentum instead of controlled rowing

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, row the bar to your lower ribs.
formCues: Flat back throughout
Pull with the elbows
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Seated, row the handle to your torso, keeping your back upright.
formCues: Chest tall, avoid leaning far back to pull
commonMistakes: Rounding the shoulders forward between reps

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: With straight arms on a high cable, pull the bar down to your thighs in an arc.
formCues: Keep a slight elbow bend, arms move as one unit
commonMistakes: Bending the elbows to turn it into a pushdown

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Hinged over a T-bar, row the handles to your chest.
formCues: Keep the back flat and braced
commonMistakes: Jerking the weight with the lower back

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
instructions: One arm at a time, row the handle to your ribs while resisting torso rotation.
formCues: Keep hips and shoulders square
commonMistakes: Rotating the torso to move more weight

name: Reverse Fly
instructions: Hinged forward, raise dumbbells out to the sides, squeezing the rear shoulders.
formCues: Slight elbow bend, lead with the elbows
commonMistakes: Using momentum to swing the weights up

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Curl the EZ-bar up to shoulder height, keeping elbows fixed at your sides.
formCues: Elbows stay pinned to your sides
commonMistakes: Swinging the torso to generate momentum

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Seated on an incline bench, curl dumbbells with arms hanging straight down.
formCues: Let the shoulder stay pinned back, no swinging
commonMistakes: Letting elbows drift forward

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl dumbbells with a neutral (palms-in) grip.
formCues: Keep wrists neutral and elbows fixed
commonMistakes: Using shoulder momentum instead of the arm

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Seated, press dumbbells overhead to full extension.
formCues: Keep ribs down, avoid over-arching the lower back
commonMistakes: Flaring elbows out too wide at the bottom

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
formCues: Lead with the elbows, not the hands
commonMistakes: Swinging the weight up with momentum

name: Rear-Delt Fly
instructions: Hinged forward, raise dumbbells out to the sides targeting the rear shoulders.
formCues: Keep a soft bend in the elbows
commonMistakes: Standing too upright, shifting work to the traps

name: Face Pull
instructions: At a high cable with a rope, pull toward your face, flaring elbows out wide.
formCues: Pull to eye level, elbows high
commonMistakes: Pulling low toward the chest instead of the face

name: Hack Squat
instructions: On a hack squat machine, lower under control until thighs are near parallel, then drive up.
formCues: Knees track over the toes
commonMistakes: Only using a partial range of motion

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: With a slight knee bend, hinge at the hips and lower the bar along your legs, then drive hips forward.
formCues: Flat back, bar stays close to the legs
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back
Squatting instead of hinging

name: Leg Press
instructions: On a leg press machine, lower the platform under control, then press through your heels.
formCues: Don't let the lower back round off the pad
commonMistakes: Locking the knees out hard at the top

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on a bench, lower the front knee toward the floor, then drive back up.
formCues: Keep most of the weight through the front foot
commonMistakes: Front knee caving inward

name: Leg Curl
instructions: On a leg curl machine, curl the pad toward your glutes under control.
formCues: Avoid lifting the hips off the pad
commonMistakes: Using momentum to swing the weight

name: Leg Extension
instructions: On a leg extension machine, extend your knees until legs are straight, then lower with control.
formCues: Control the negative, don't drop the weight
commonMistakes: Using a jerky, fast tempo

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Holding dumbbells, step forward into a lunge and continue alternating legs as you travel.
formCues: Torso upright, front knee over the ankle
commonMistakes: Taking too short a step, limiting range of motion

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneeling under a high cable, crunch down by flexing the spine, not just bending at the hips.
formCues: Round the spine, keep hips still
commonMistakes: Hinging at the hips instead of flexing the spine
